easyPrerequisites: You control nine or fewer lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
